_comment: SKYRUSH landmarks - placement and lighting contract for the world unit. Map frame: X east, Z south, Y up (metres). anchor = the node's world position; rotation_y = the Godot Y rotation to apply (0 for the towers). The three bridges are modelled in a bridge-local frame: origin at the anchor, local +Y along the deck.

assets.name: oriental_pearl
assets.notes: Oriental Pearl Tower. The LED_Sphere_* meshes carry the LED dot skin; the wrapper (oriental_pearl.tscn) puts a ShaderMaterial on them (materials/opt_dots.gdshader): a 0.4 m dot grid with a 0.75 Hz chase wave, the colour cycled pink #FF3FA4 -> violet #8A3CFF -> blue #2E7BFF over 40 s, and the five small spheres at E5. The tubes carry a baked flood wash (warm #FFF1E0 at the foot, violet #7A4CFF up the shafts), a light ring every 10 m and a 2.4 m LED strip. The glass is #B0306A. NOTE: led_cycle.gd casts to StandardMaterial3D and skips ShaderMaterials - the sphere colour is driven by the wrapper (materials/opt_led.gd).

assets.name: pearl_ring
assets.notes: Pearl Ring skybridge, deck top Y = 6.7 m, girder soffit 5.7 m (5.5 m clearance kept). PearlRing_ColDeck-colonly is the trimesh collision ring; PearlRing_ColColumns / _ColStairs are the column and stair hulls.

assets.name: jin_mao
assets.notes: Jin Mao, 13 octagonal tiers. Use the wrapper scene: it applies the shared facade shader (materials/lujiazui_facade.tres) with this tower's building_seed. LED_JinMao_Edges is the gold #FFD27A setback wash (3.2 m tall); LED_JinMao_Crown is the gold-white lattice crown and mast (#FFE6A8, E3.5).

assets.name: swfc
assets.notes: SWFC. Wrapper scene for the facade shader. LED_SWFC_Edges = the 2.4 m white arris + aperture outline (#CFE6FF, E3.5). The inverted-trapezoid aperture is 440-472 m; SWFC_Skywalk is the 100F beam at 474 m; a 4-floor 15.8 m podium sits at the base.

assets.name: shanghai_tower
assets.notes: Shanghai Tower, 120 twisted rings + crown fins to 632 m. Wrapper scene for the facade shader. LED_Tower_Bands = the white floor-band dots (#E6F2FF); LED_Tower_CornerLines = the three twisting corner lines (1.6 m, E3); LED_Tower_Notch = the 2.0 m V-notch line (E3.5); LED_Tower_Crown / _CrownTop = the lit crown faces and the ring on the sloped top edge.

assets.name: lujiazui_backdrop
assets.notes: 12 generic Lujiazui towers, 150-256 m, each with three setbacks, a crown cap and an antenna. Seven of them (IFC_A, IFC_B, HSBC, CMB, Aurora, IFC_C, Citi) carry cool-white LED_Crown_<name> edge lines and a crown ring. Every roof has a red aviation beacon (LED_Aviation_<name>, 1 Hz). The three LED ad screens are LED_Ad_IFC_C / _CMB / _Aurora (60 x 120 m, own 1024 x 576 ads, energy 2.5).

assets.name: dragon_pillar
assets.notes: Nine-Dragon Pillar, D 5.0 m column with a 0.12 m displaced relief. The relief ships as base colour + normal (4096 x 8192) + a real ORM map (R = AO, G = roughness, B = metalness) and the glb carries a metallicRoughnessTexture. Flood_Base_1..4 stand on the plinth rim (r 3.1 m, y 0.65 m) and graze the column at 86 deg; LED_Pillar_Uplights are their lens housings and LED_Pillar_Plinth the warm line under the plinth lip.

assets.name: nanpu_bridge
assets.notes: Nanpu Bridge in bridge-local frame: origin = main-span midpoint, local +Y towards Pudong (map axis 0.901, 0.434). Road Y = 45.5 midspan, 44.0 at the towers, 42.5 at the Puxi deck end. The carriageway comes from the roads unit; only the towers, cables, name sign and deck edge LEDs are here. The legs and the lower crossbeam carry a baked flood wash (LED_Nanpu_WashLow / _WashHigh) because the real floods never reach the 150 m tops; LED_Nanpu_DeckEdge is the 0.5 m blue line on both sides, LED_Nanpu_UnderStrip the orange strip under the deck. Flood_Nanpu_Leg_* = the 8 tower floods, Flood_Nanpu_Under_* the deck soffit.

assets.name: lupu_bridge_far
assets.notes: Lupu Bridge far silhouette (backdrop only), local +Y = map +X. Use the wrapper scene: it turns the fog off for the LED_Lupu_* materials so the rainbow running lights read from the Nanpu deck 2.2 km away. The rainbow texture is a fully saturated hue sweep (S 1, V 1) at E1.4 - at E3.4 the arch clipped to white.

assets.name: waibaidu_bridge
assets.notes: Waibaidu Bridge in bridge-local frame: origin at the creek centre, local +Y along the road (map axis 0.145, -0.989). 2 spans of 52.18 m, truss centres 12.192 m apart, the pier spans the full width under the trusses. The carriageway (11.2 m clear) comes from the roads unit; Waibaidu_ColDeck-colonly is the collision plate and Waibaidu_ColTruss-colonly the truss walls.

lights.note: the four grazing warm uplights on the plinth rim, aimed up the column at 87 deg so the beam rakes the relief
deck soffit light under the top deck

the twelve wash lights: four at each of three heights (4, 13, 22 m), 6 m out and aimed horizontally at the column. A vertical beam on a vertical cylinder meets it at 0.05 of the cosine, so four uplights can only reach the bottom third; these light a 8 m band each, so the column reads warm silver from the plinth to the top deck.
podium floods around the three tube feet
4 per tower, 3 m outboard of each leg face at deck level, aimed up the leg (the baked wash carries the tops)
orange underside wash of the deck
4 per truss on the sidewalks, aimed at the steel
